```artifact
# Lab Request Management Test Suite

Feature: Lab Request Management
  As a lab user, I want to view and update open lab requests and submit reports offline
  My lab requests should be accessible and updatable by the lab in-charge.
  I want to view my prescriptions and be able to print and email the invoice.
  I expect that my patient profile will be archived quarterly if I haven'thy raised any consultation requests in the last 3 years.

  Background:
    Given the lab system is operational
    And the lab in-charge has access to view and update lab requests
    And the patient system allows viewing of prescriptions and printing/emailing of invoices
    And the quarterly archiving process for old consultation requests is in place

  Scenario: Viewing and Updating Open Lab Requests
    @U31_10
    When I log in as a lab in-charge
    And I navigate to the lab requests section
    Then I should see all open lab requests
    And I should be able to update the status of each request
    And all reports should be available for offline viewing and submission

  Scenario: Viewing and Printing Prescription and Invoice
    @U11
    Given a patient with a prescription and pending invoice
    When I log in as a patient
    And I access my prescription and invoice
    Then I should see the prescription details
    And I should be able to print and email the invoice

  Scenario: Archiving Patient Profiles and Consultation Requests
    @U12
    Given a patient with no consultation requests in the last 3 years
    And it's been a quarter since the last archiving
    When the quarterly archiving process is triggered
    Then the patient's profile should be archived
    And all consultation requests older than 3 years should be archived

  Scenario: Edge Case: Patient with Recent Consultation Requests
    @U12
    Given a patient with at least one consultation request in the last 3 years
    And it's been a quarter since the last archiving
    When the quarterly archiving process is triggered
    Then the patient's profile should not be archived
    And only the oldest consultation request older than 3 years should be archived

  Scenario: Boundary Case: Patient with Multiple Consultation Requests
    @U12
    Given a patient with multiple consultation requests, some within the last 3 years and some older than 3 years
    And it's been a quarter since the last archiving
    When the quarterly archiving process is triggered
    Then only the oldest consultation request older than 3 years should be archived

  Scenario: Invalid Input for Prescription and Invoice
    @U11
    Given a patient with a prescription and pending invoice
    When I enter incorrect details for the prescription or invoice
    Then I should see an error message

  Scenario: Negative Path: Incorrect Archiving Process
    @U12
    Given a patient with multiple consultation requests, all within the last 3 years
    When the quarterly archiving process is triggered
    Then all patient profiles and consultation requests should remain active

  Scenario: Oracle Assertiveness: Correct Archiving Outcome
    @U12
    Given a patient with multiple consultation requests, some within the last 3 years and some older than 3 years
    When the quarterly archiving process is triggered
    Then only the oldest consultation request older than 3 years should be archived

  Scenario: Oracle Assertiveness: Incorrect Archiving Outcome
    @U12
    Given a patient with multiple consultation requests, all within the last 3 years
    When the quarterly archiving process is triggered
    Then no patient profiles or consultation requests should be archived

  Scenario: Error Path: Incorrect Archiving Process
    @U12
    Given a patient with multiple consultation requests, all within the last 3 years
    When the quarterly archiving process is triggered with a malfunction
    Then an error should be thrown, and no archiving should occur
```
